summary:
Main
Today, the iron ore market showed a slightly weaker trend on the futures side. The DCE main contract I2609 closed at 713.5 yuan/ton, down 0.35%from the previous trading session. Spot prices at Qingdao Port declined by an average of about 0-2 yuan/ton from the previous day.
